intro.text: The spiritual makeup of a person, which some fabrials can read accurately, though they go haywire on heavily Invested people.
The network of Connections and Investiture that makes up the soul of a creature, place, object or planet. It resides in the Spiritual Realm and has no tangible shape or size.

description.text: Zinc and brass Allomancy work only on creatures with enough sapience, and work better on those whose spiritweb is damaged.
Regrowth, or enough Stormlight, can heal a spiritweb as well as the body.
A Bondsmith bonded to the Stormfather can read a person's spiritweb, seeing it as faintly glowing lines whose thickness shows the strength of each Connection.
Physical or emotional trauma can crack a spiritweb, and power can enter a person more easily through those cracks.
A wound someone has come to see as part of themselves may not heal, even by magic.
